name: Saltcombe
subtitle: The Bell of Tides
author: Luminati
description: Chapter Two of The Bells of Evermere: a harbour town on a cove locked in sea ice in the late morning — its ships frozen in the bay, the broken mole, the harbour basin where something waits under the ice, the lighthouse of the Bell of Tides on the headland. Generated by tools/make-bells-of-evermere.mjs.

objects.name: The Net Loft
text: The nets are frozen into one grey block. Somebody has chalked FEE PAID on it.

objects.name: The Harbour Office
text: HARBOUR OFFICE. Fees payable in advance. Complaints payable in advance.

objects.name: The Ship Chandler
text: CLOSED FOR THE SEASON. The season has lasted seven years.

objects.name: Bessa's Fish
text: The smell of fish has outlasted the fish. Impressive, in its way.

objects.name: The Sailors' Chapel
text: Seven years of names on the board by the door: the boats that went out the night the ice came.

objects.name: Gull Cottage
text: Empty. A kettle on a cold hob, and the gulls nesting in the chimney.

objects.name: Pilot's Cottage
text: The pilot's house. Her charts of the bay are pinned to the shutters — iced over, every one.

objects.name: Salt Cottage
text: A sign: GONE TO EVERMERE. BACK WHEN THE TIDE IS.

objects.name: The Lamp Room Store
text: Oil, wicks, and a ledger. Every night for seven years, one tally mark: a lamp lit. The last page is nearly full.

objects.speaker: Signpost
text: No mooring past the second bollard. — W. Gale

objects.name: Bessa
dialogue: Fish! Fresh fish! Well — fish. Seven years in a barrel of ice, they're fresher than I am.
Draughts too, if you're hurt. Wenna makes me keep them. Says it's a harbour regulation. It isn't.
